title: Second Brain note frontmatter
description: The frontmatter schema every note in this vault is expected to satisfy, except CLAUDE.md and README.md (repo-facing files with no frontmatter at all). This is documentation of intent: _system/lint.py enforces the same rules in code, and is the actual source of truth if the two ever disagree. The parser in _system/vaultlib.py understands exactly this shape (plain scalars, quoted string scalars, inline lists, full-line comments) and nothing beyond it, see that file's module docstring.

description.description: One line: what the note covers and when to read it.

review.description: How often last_verified must be refreshed. lint.py flags a note whose last_verified is older than this cadence allows.

area.description: Picks which folder-level topic block this note belongs to. See AGENTS.md section 2 for what each area is for.

aliases.description: Alternate titles that wikilinks can resolve to. lint.py rejects an alias that duplicates another note's alias, or that collides with an existing note's title.

deadline.description: Optional. A date-bound item: a notice period, a statement due date, a rent-adjustment window. lint.py flags anything inside its lookahead window (default 30 days, --deadline-days to change it) and anything already passed.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. lint.py rejects any other format for created, modified, and last_verified, and for deadline when present.
